title: Moses Maimonides
html_source:
Moses Maimonides, original name Moses Ben Maimon, also called Rambam, Arabic name Abū ʿImran Mūsā ibn Maymūn ibn ʿUbayd Allāh (born March 30, 1135, Córdoba [Spain]—died Dec. 13, 1204, Egypt) Jewish philosopher, jurist, and physician, the foremost intellectual figure of medieval Judaism.
Encyclopedia Britannica.

See https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b00yjqz3
